question: does the 2021 gen2 surface hit its own surveyed QA checkpoints, and by how much does it sit low or high at each one?

inputs.role: surveyed 3DEP QA checkpoints near Elba, NAVD88(GEOID18) -- the SAME datum as gen2, so no geoid term is applied
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2210_2021_MN (fetched at EPT depth 12)
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 3056_2021_MN (fetched at EPT depth 12)
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2024_2021_MN (fetched at EPT depth 12)
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2036_2021_MN (fetched at EPT depth 12)
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 2099_2021_MN (fetched at EPT depth 12)
gen2 2021 3DEP full-density box around checkpoint 3089_2021_MN (fetched at EPT depth 12)

params.name: checkpoint_set
params.why: the six 3DEP vertical-accuracy marks within ~12 km of Elba

params.name: ground_source
params.why: pipeline.read_after_ground default mode='class2' -- gen2's own vendor bare earth, the ground the product is built from

params.name: geoid_shift_mm
params.why: checkpoints are NAVD88(GEOID18) and gen2 is NAVD88(GEOID18) (ABSOLUTE_ELEVATION_REFS.md section 1a, verified from the shapefile .prj and the project report), so NO geoid term applies on this side. The measurement below is itself the check on that claim: a wrong geoid model would show as a ~70 mm offset at every mark.

params.name: swath_shift_m
params.why: gen2 is the frame gen1 was registered INTO; it carries no chain, no internal swath alignment and no lateral shift of its own

params.name: box_half_width_m
params.why: the fetched gen2 box around each mark. The widest fitting radius on the ladder is 25 m, so this excludes nothing from any estimate; it is sized so the 3DEP node tiles fetch in seconds.

params.name: nva_tolerance_mm
params.why: USGS project report / VA text files for the QL1 block covering Winona County: NVA 3.5 cm RMSEz, VVA 27 cm at the 95th percentile; quoted in analysis/ridgelines/ABSOLUTE_ELEVATION_REFS.md section 1b

params.name: vva_tolerance_mm
params.why: USGS project report / VA text files for the QL1 block covering Winona County: NVA 3.5 cm RMSEz, VVA 27 cm at the 95th percentile; quoted in analysis/ridgelines/ABSOLUTE_ELEVATION_REFS.md section 1b

columns.R_m: radius of the fitting window about the checkpoint, m
columns.n: gen2 ground returns inside the report radius, count
columns.tie_mm: surveyed elevation minus lidar ground at the mark, after the swath and geoid terms; the constant to ADD to gen1, mm
columns.fit_rms_mm: RMS of z_i - S(x_i,y_i) for the local surface fit S, mm
columns.medres_mm: median of those residuals -- the slope-normal quantile term, mm
columns.relief_m: p95 - p05 of return elevations inside the radius, m
columns.n_lines: distinct flight lines contributing returns inside the radius, count
columns.scan_deg: |scan angle| p05/p50/p95 of those returns, degrees (0 = nadir)
columns.type: NVA = open ground, VVA = under vegetation (3DEP convention)
columns.gen2_mm: surveyed minus gen2 ground at the mark -- the constant to ADD to gen2; POSITIVE means gen2 sits LOW, mm
columns.sigma_mm: half the tie's spread across the pipeline-scale radii, mm
columns.gen2_med_mm: the same tie taken as the median over the pipeline-scale radii, mm
columns.gen1_mm: gen1's tie at the same mark, for comparison, mm
columns.epoch_mm: gen1 tie minus gen2 tie: how much MORE the 2008 surface sits low than the 2021 one at this mark, mm
columns.usable: does the radius spread fall inside 3DEP's own accuracy for the point's class
columns.note: why a mark has no gen2 tie, where it has none
columns.density: gen2 ground returns per square metre inside the box

headline: gen2 vs its own checkpoints: 2210=-1mm, 3056=+28mm, 2024=+35mm, 2036=+59mm, 2099=-44mm, 3089=-109mm
